# transmit_oncall_responder (Resource)

A person who can be paged. Transmit pages by email until the responder verifies phone contacts in the dashboard; changing `email` or disabling the responder revokes that verification.

Deleting is refused while a team, schedule or escalation policy still names the responder, so reference responders by id and Terraform orders the deletes for you.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "transmit_oncall_responder" "dana" {
  configuration_id = transmit_oncall_configuration.prod.id
  name             = "Dana Reyes"
  email            = "dana@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration_id` (String) The on-call configuration this belongs to. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `email` (String) Lowercase email address, unique within the configuration.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `disabled` (Boolean) A disabled responder is never paged. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `contact_verified` (Boolean) Whether the responder has verified a phone contact for SMS and voice paging.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <configuration_id>/<responder_id>
terraform import transmit_oncall_responder.dana 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002
```
